'''July 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut on 14 July 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2672">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-20-meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-auditd2672/ meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-audit], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 20 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-20-meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-auditd2672/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
